case.query: If I have a weakened immune system due to HIV or cancer, why might the Pneumocystis fungus that is usually harmless start making me sick?
evidence: But it can make you sick if you have a weakened immune system , for example if you: Have HIV Have an autoimmune disease Have cancer Have a chronic (long-lasting) lung disease Had an organ or bone marrow transplant Take medicines which weaken your immune system, such as chemotherapy and steroids How does Pneumocystis jirovecii spread?
